caption: The drawing depicts a large bird rendered primarily in shades of yellow and brown, standing on what appears to be a cluster of five rounded, yellowish objects that resemble eggs. The bird features intricate patterns, with zigzags and lines covering its wings, body, and tail to represent texture or feathers. Its wings are outstretched, with both the left and right wings and the tail display having the same stylized markings. The bird’s beak is pointed and colored with darker tones, and there is a circular pattern depicting its eye. Below and to the left and right of the main bird are two smaller birds, similar in shape and color, each also standing on what appears to be a small cluster of rounded yellow objects. The background of the image is plain and light beige, and the artist's name, "TULITA WESTFALL," is printed in small letters at the bottom left corner of the drawing.
